fair_value_reason: P/E: 19.5x NTM EPS at Sep-2027 of ~$7.40 (0.25 x FY27 $6.88 + 0.75 x FY28 $7.57) = $144.3, at weight 0.7. I shaded FY27 from $6.93 for the stalled traffic, and FY28 is +10% for algorithm growth plus lapping the outbreak. FCF yield: ~$6.15/share (ex-Pizza Hut OCF ~$1.95B less ~$0.35B capex over ~262M shares; agent_2's $6.70 corrected) at 4.4% = $140, at weight 0.3. The blend is $143.0. Then subtract explicit per-share adjustments rather than treating them as weighted methods: net outbreak litigation ~-$0.7 (agent_3's -$0.6, folded in properly) and IRS 2014 expected value ~-$0.4 (3% x ~-$15). That gives ~$142. This is $3 below the agents' mean of $145, mainly from agent_2's FCF correction, the litigation and IRS adjustment, and slightly lower FY27 EPS. The ~2.2% dividend is not included.
supervisor_summary: Round 2 tightened the five forecasts around my round-1 numbers (mean P(>=136) 0.554, fair value $145), but mostly because every agent adopted the same fact-check, so the agreement is not new evidence. agent_3 correctly overturned my 'y/y' reading of Placer's weekly data: the reads are against the H1-2026 baseline. A newer late-August read shows Taco Bell stuck about 7-8 points below QSR peers, so the recovery has stalled rather than closing. With agent_2's FCF corrected and litigation and the unreserved IRS claim folded in explicitly (~-$1/share), I put fair value at $142, P(>=136) at 0.535, and the thesis break at $110. This is a medium-confidence 2-point nudge below the mean, since September's 11% drop already priced much of the stall. The Nov 3 print is the next real test.
key_drivers: Taco Bell traffic recovery has stalled. Placer's weekly reads are versus the H1-2026 average, not y/y: -4.5% (Aug 10-16) against QSR +3.2%, and -6.1% (Aug 24-30) against QSR +1.6%. That is a steady gap of about -7.7 points to peers. The year-over-year average for Jul 6-Sep 11 is -12.2%. The Nov 3 print will show this.

The EPS base is still being cut. Live FY27 consensus is $6.93, down from $7.46 a month ago, and already includes the ~$1.6B proceeds buyback. The stalled traffic makes more cuts likely into and after Nov 3.

Valuation is undemanding. The stock trades ~19.7x FY27 and ~18.4x NTM-at-Sep-27 (~$7.40), and is down ~18% since Jul 6 while SPY rose ~2%. A flat 19.5x multiple gives ~$144 before adjustments. The reference cases (Taco Bell 2006, McDonald's 2024) recovered on price within ~3-4 quarters, but MCD lagged SPY by ~18 points over that year.

Tail items: net cyclospora litigation (~$0.6-0.8/share, no accrual), securities investigations (headline and governance risk), and the unreserved IRS 2014 claim (~$17.7/share gross; Tax Court; no resolution expected within 12 months). Together they are worth ~-$1/share of expected value plus a fatter left tail.
Lapping the outbreak from July 2027 falls inside the horizon. Even a slow recovery gives easy Q3-27 comparisons, which supports the base case at the Sep-2027 date.
